name: get_core_services_status
description: Returns the status (running/stopped/failed) of NuCore core services: isy, udx, eisyui, mosquitto.ud, etc. No params. Cheap and side-effect-free -- call it freely for any question about whether the system's core services are up, and before restart_core_service to confirm the exact service name. For a not-responding/no-status-feedback complaint specifically, prefer diagnostics_not_responding/diagnostics_no_status_feedback instead -- they already check this internally as part of their investigation.
